summary.question: 上季度各会员等级的复购率

payload.question: 上季度各会员等级的复购率

metrics.label: 复购率
metrics.description: 统计周期内下单 2 次及以上的用户数 ÷ 统计周期内下单用户数。按维度拆分时在每个分组内分别计算。

answer.text: 上季度（2026年第3季度），复购率最高的会员等级是黑金会员（41.8%），最低的是普通会员（24.8%）。

queries.title: 复购率
queries.sql:
SELECT
  t.member_level AS member_level,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_buyers,
  COUNT(*) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    4
  ) AS repurchase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id AS customer_id,
    c.member_level AS member_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_in_period
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY
    o.customer_id,
    c.member_level
) AS t
GROUP BY
  t.member_level
ORDER BY
  repurchase_rate DESC,
  member_level
LIMIT 1000
